note: RunsOn is a solo-founder, bootstrapped side/main project of Cyril Rohr (France), previously creator of Packager.io (2013) and PullPreview.com (2018). It is explicitly self-funded with no VC investment, monetized via a paid licence tier layered on top of AWS usage (customers pay AWS directly plus a RunsOn fee). Core server/agent code is open-source-adjacent (developed in the open on GitHub) but the full source with Enterprise features requires a commercial tier.
